text: A compiler turns declarative components into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM
quote: It's a compiler that takes your declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM.

text: Write concise components that do minimal work in the browser using HTML, CSS and JavaScript
quote: write breathtakingly concise components that do minimal work in the browser, using languages you already know — HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

text: A public roadmap shows what the team is currently working on
quote: You may view our roadmap if you'd like to see what we're currently working on.

text: An official Discord chatroom is available for the community
quote: stop by the Discord chatroom

text: Svelte Society runs events around the globe with local chapters you can join
quote: Our sister organisation, Svelte Society, organises events around the globe. Find your chapter and join us in our Discord server.

text: Scaffold a new SvelteKit app with the npx sv create command
quote: The easiest way to start building a SvelteKit app is to run `npx sv create`

text: State has no special API; reactive values are plain variables you update normally
quote: there is no API for interacting with state — `count` is just a number, rather than an object or a function, and you can update it like you would update any other variable.

text: The $state rune creates reactive state so the UI updates when it changes
quote: The `$state` rune allows you to create _reactive state_, which means that your UI _reacts_ when it changes.

text: $derived computes reactive values from their dependencies
quote: `$derived` computes reactive values based on dependencies.

text: $derived.by supports multi-line or complex derivation logic
quote: Use $derived.by for multi-line or complex logic.

text: Derived values can be temporarily reassigned for optimistic UI and revert when dependencies update
quote: You can reassign a derived value for features like optimistic UI. It will go back to the `$derived` value once an update in its dependencies happen.

text: $effect runs functions when reactive state changes
quote: $effect executes functions when reactive state changes.

text: Effects run after DOM updates and can return teardown functions
quote: Effects run after the DOM updates and can return teardown functions.

text: $state.raw creates shallow state where mutations are not tracked
quote: `$state.raw` creates shallow state where mutations are not tracked.

text: $state can be used in class fields to create reactive properties
quote: Use `$state` in class fields for reactive properties.

text: CSS in a component's style block is scoped to that component
quote: CSS inside a `<style>` block will be scoped to that component.

text: .svelte.js and .svelte.ts modules can use runes for reusable reactive logic and app-wide shared state
quote: These behave like any other `.js` or `.ts` module, except that you can use runes. This is useful for creating reusable reactive logic, or sharing reactive state across your app

text: Component script blocks support TypeScript via lang="ts"
quote: A `<script>` block contains JavaScript (or TypeScript, when adding the `lang="ts"` attribute) that runs when a component instance is created.

text: Svelte 4 syntax not listed as changed, like {#if} blocks, stays the same, so existing knowledge carries over
quote: Other syntax not explicitly listed like `{#if ...}` blocks stay the same, so you can reuse your Svelte 4 knowledge for these.

text: sv check finds unused CSS, accessibility hints and JS/TS compiler errors from the command line
quote: `sv check` finds errors and warnings in your project, such as: unused CSS, accessibility hints, JavaScript/TypeScript compiler errors

text: sv add updates an existing project with new functionality
quote: `sv add` updates an existing project with new functionality.

text: sv add can install local add-ons from a file path for development or internal use
quote: # Use a local add-on (for development or internal use) npx sv add file:../path/to/my-addon

text: Create a full SvelteKit project from a playground URL, with external dependencies detected automatically
quote: Create a SvelteKit project from a playground URL. This downloads all playground files, detects external dependencies, and sets up a complete SvelteKit project structure

text: The CLI includes a library template set up with svelte-package
quote: `library` — template for a Svelte library, set up with `svelte-package`

text: The CLI installs dependencies with npm, pnpm, yarn, bun or deno
quote: Installs dependencies with a specified package manager: npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, deno

text: SvelteKit is a full-stack meta-framework comparable to Next (React) or Nuxt (Vue)
quote: If you're coming from React, SvelteKit is similar to Next. If you're coming from Vue, SvelteKit is similar to Nuxt.

text: File-based routing in src/routes, with pages server-rendered for fast first visits
quote: You create pages by adding files to the `src/routes` directory of your project. These will be server-rendered so that a user's first visit to your app is as fast as possible

text: SvelteKit can act as a static site generator that fully prerenders sites with adapter-static
quote: You can use SvelteKit as a static site generator (SSG) that fully prerenders your site with static rendering using `adapter-static`.

text: Single-page apps can be built using client-side rendering only
quote: Single-page apps (SPAs) exclusively use client-side rendering (CSR).

text: Different rendering types can be mixed and matched on different pages
quote: SvelteKit allows for nicely mixing and matching different rendering types on different pages.

text: Incremental Static Regeneration is available with adapter-vercel to avoid long build times
quote: you can avoid long build times with Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) if using `adapter-vercel`

text: Vite-powered dev server reflects code changes in the browser instantly
quote: It reflects changes to your code in the browser instantly to provide a lightning-fast and feature-rich development experience by leveraging Vite

text: SvelteKit provides build optimizations, offline support, page preloading before navigation and image optimization
quote: Its extensive list of features includes build optimizations...; offline support; preloading pages before user navigation; ... image optimization

text: npm run build outputs static HTML, JS and CSS files into a dist directory
quote: With this, `npm run build` will generate HTML, JS, and CSS files inside the `dist` directory.

text: Svelte can be tried online in a browser playground
quote: You can also try Svelte online in the playground.

text: An official VS Code extension is maintained, with integrations for other editors and tools
quote: The Svelte team maintains a VS Code extension, and there are integrations with various other editors and tools as well.

text: An official Svelte MCP server gives agents relevant docs and statically analyzes the code they generate
quote: The Svelte MCP (Model Context Protocol) server can help your agent write better Svelte code. It works by providing relevant documentation, and statically analysing generated code

text: The MCP server can be added to Claude Code via a single npx-based command
quote: claude mcp add -t stdio -s [scope] svelte -- npx -y @sveltejs/mcp

text: The svelte-autofixer tool analyzes Svelte code and returns issues and suggestions
quote: svelte-autofixer: Analyzes Svelte code and returns issues and suggestions.

text: Subagents can run atomic operations in parallel, each in a separate context window
quote: Subagents: focused agents that can be invoked in parallel to execute atomic operations in a separate context window
